Their alleged reunion comes after Khushi’s much-talked-about relationship with her The Archies co-star Vedang Raina.

recentItems.title: Sonu Sood Reaches Flood-Hit Nepal! Visits Devastated Trishuli, Promises FULL Support
recentItems.description:
Sonu Sood stepped forward to support flood victims in Nepal as he visited the devastated Trishuli region. Witnessing the destruction firsthand, the actor assured affected families of complete assistance and support. His visit highlighted his humanitarian efforts as he pledged to stand with those struggling to recover from the devastating floods.
